item.title: Windrush compensation support gets £600,000 funding boost
item.body: Windrush victims will continue to receive dedicated compensation support, backed by an extra £600,000 in funding.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 💷 Windrush compensation support gets £600,000 funding boost

Windrush victims will continue to receive dedicated compensation support, backed by an extra £600,000 in funding.

Source: GOV.UK Home Office | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 9 November, 15:50
